notes.title: New update on August 1!
notes.content:
We follow your wishes and comments in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1065210/discussions/]Steam discussions[/url], so we prepared a new update where we tried to take into account most of it.

Changes:
[list]
[*] Get rid of invisible enemies 
[*] Enemies no longer attack when you open game windows 
[*] Fixed bugs with getting diamonds 
[*] Change of save date after overriding the current save 
[*] Forbidden to swim on land on a raft 
[/list]

notes.title: New Fuel Production System! Check it out!
notes.content:
It turned out our fuel production system didn't work properly (Thanks [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198086183746]Casper[/url] for the info about it) and we decided to fix it and rework a bit.

Now it produces [b]1 fuel per minute[/b] in real time for your convenience. You can speed up with 2 coals x2 for a minute or with 50 diamonds x5 for a week.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35119009/fbea2f15a044ed0b8655868c14bec7d726126d08.png[/img]

We hope the new system will greatly help you on your journey to islands! 

P.S. [b]Don't forget to update ZIC: Survival[/b] to check the new fuel production system

P.P.S. Don't afraid to communicate with us [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1065210/discussions/]here[/url]. We're checking it every day!
